setName: Authored public-atlas retrieval sanity set, revision 1
scope: Small authored sanity set; labels selected from this corpus before running comparisons. Not a held-out benchmark, SOTA assessment, or general retrieval-quality estimate.

method.lexicalBaseline: Same production queryGraph implementation with alpha=0. Graph mass stays at lexical seeds; the unchanged reciprocal-rank fusion still executes. This is not a separately implemented pure BM25 scorer.
method.default: Same queryGraph with alpha=0.85 and default relation allowlist; no core or parameter changes were made to improve outcomes.
method.success: At least one predeclared acceptable ID among returned records, with an identical maximum of six results and 12288 bytes.
method.mrr: Mean reciprocal rank of first acceptable ID over 12 answerable questions. Acceptable sets are intentionally bounded, not exhaustive relevance labels.
method.abstention: Zero records is required for an absent-answer control. Returning topically related records fails this conservative check; the retriever does not synthesize an answer.

comparisonConclusion: Default graph propagation does not improve Success@6 on this small authored set.

timing.query: Which dependencies must a result cache key include when source evidence or scope policy changes?
timing.sequence: Five TTL=0 runs, one untimed cache-populating query, five TTL=3600000 warm runs
timing.limits: No-result-cache cold only: filesystem and process/JIT caches were not cleared. Each measured store query reloads, verifies and filters the snapshot. Five samples in one process are noisy and order-dependent; no provider token, billable-money or inference-cache saving follows.
